checks.title: Audit trail is untampered
checks.summary: All 278 entries verify, and the recorded chain tip (#278) matches the last entry.
detail: Every entry's hash was recomputed and linked to its predecessor.
The chain tip was compared with the last entry, so deleted trailing entries would be caught.

checks.title: Audit table is write-protected
checks.summary: The app's database role can UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE audit entries. The hash chain would still DETECT tampering, but the database does not PREVENT it.
detail: Connected as database role "fab" via DATABASE_URL (fallback) (a superuser).
checks.remedy: Run prisma/scripts/create-restricted-role.sql as the database owner, then point RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL at the new app_runtime role (keep DIRECT_URL on the owner for migrations and seeding).

checks.title: One booking per date is enforced by the database
checks.summary: A unique index prevents two CONFIRMED (or cancellation-pending) bookings on the same date — even under concurrent requests.
detail: Index "Booking_held_eventDate_key" is unique and applies to: (status = ANY (ARRAY['CONFIRMED'::"BookingStatus", 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED'::"BookingStatus"]))

checks.title: No booking breaks a business rule
detail: Booking cmu9pemym0014ny7dj4dkq8zh (2027-01-23) is CONFIRMED without a verified deposit
checks.remedy: Fix each record: cancel or decline the duplicate booking, or record/verify the missing deposit. (Records created by an old code path or direct database edits can look like this; the new gate makes new ones impossible.)

checks.title: No audit entry has been lost
